description: Land Commissioner General's Department - Appointed Land Officers, under Land Development Ordinance
categorisation: This gazette contains multiple appointments of named individuals (Land Officers) under the Land Development Ordinance. While these are government personnel appointments, they specifically relate to land administration and are made by the Land Commissioner General. This falls under judicial/law enforcement gazettes (Type 9) as it involves appointments of officials responsible for land law enforcement and administration, rather than general government ministerial appointments or structural changes.
